title: Red cabbage, apple and lentil soup

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything here is a whole food or plain staple, and vegetable stock is allowed as good stock.

supermarket.reason: Red cabbage, Puy lentils, crème fraîche and caraway are all everyday items at Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded pan, a knife and a grater, with simple softening and simmering.

works.reason: 200g Puy lentils, half a cabbage and 1.2 litres of stock simmered for 35 to 40 minutes gives a properly cooked, chunky soup for four, and the vinegar and caraway keep it lively.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is fair for chopping two onions and two carrots, shredding half a cabbage and grating an apple, and 50 minutes of cooking matches the 10 minute soften plus 40 minute simmer.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, nothing unlisted appears, and the eating apple matches its id.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot, hearty red cabbage soup suits late December, and half a cabbage makes it the clear star.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English, with no fuss or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lentils, plenty of vegetables and a spoonful of crème fraîche make a filling, wholesome lunch.
